name: 01267 · Williamstown, MA
findings: ZIP 01267 (Williamstown) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01267 (Williamstown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01267 (Williamstown) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
